description:
**Reclaiming ownership to the creators 🌱**

Headstart is bringing web2 creators onchain via Lens Protocol, ERC-6551, and SAFE AA-wallet.

🛸 Out-of-the-box smart contract account available to web2 creators
💸 Seamlessly onboard to Lens Protocol
🪐 Built on top of wagmi and viem

We’re looking to onboard web2 creators to web3. By mirroring their existing content and deploying it via token bound accounts (ERC-6551), their creations are minted as NFTs within the account so other people can collect the posts. 

For every collect on the accounts' assets, funds will be accumulated for when the original creator is ready to claim the account by authenticating that they are the rightful owner.

By incentivizing creators with content they already created, we enable them to seamlessly enjoy the benefits of web3.
how_its_made:
Using ERC-6551 we have deployed our own NFT on polygon Mumbai using Foundry. In the contracts we used the already deployed account implementation and account registry contracts + Lens contracts. 

- Wagmi + Viem for web3 interactions
- Deployed our on subgraph to The Graph and used react-query to fetch it
- SAFE{CORE} Auth kit to generate AA wallets (and Web3auth for social login)
- Lens SDK 
- Next.js
- Tailwind 
- Turborepo
